Fetch the reference BMF (pinned archive)

Source: R/fetch.R
np_fetch_bmf.Rd

Fetch the reference BMF (pinned archive)

Usage

np_fetch_bmf(
  which = c("unified", "processed", "dictionary"),
  dest = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  quiet = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

which

Which BMF file: "unified" (active+inactive), "processed" (active only), or "dictionary".

dest, overwrite, quiet

Passed to np_fetch().

Value

The destination path, invisibly.
